name: Ool
description: Ool was a forested planet located in the Ool system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. A hyperlane linked the world to the Avidich and Shihon systems. The sentient Chiss of the Chiss Ascendancy established large circular plots of farmland across the surface of Ool.
